title: Summary: Hosted Review and Branch Rules
objective: Create a feature branch, commit a change, and print the current branch and the commits the branch adds to main.
hint: Repeat the setup: main with README, then git switch -q -c feature/hosted-review and the Hosted review note commit. Then Write-Output (git branch --show-current) and Write-Output (git log main..feature/hosted-review --format=%s).
